description: This file contains a unit test class 'I18NImportErrorTest' for testing the 'I18NImportError' entity within the internationalization (I18N) component of the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines, multiple test cases for entity constraints, and decorator functionality.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the I18NImportError entity's behavior, constraints, and decorator integration within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables and setting up initial test data entries for Employee, I18NLanguage, I18NGroup, I18NLangString, and I18NError entities.

methods.name: testI18NImportError
methods.description: Tests the creation and persistence of a fully linked I18NImportError entity and verifies its relations.

methods.name: testI18NImportErrorWithNullLangString
methods.description: Ensures that persisting I18NImportError without LangString throws a NotNullConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NImportErrorWithNullLanguage
methods.description: Ensures that persisting I18NImportError without Language throws a NotNullConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NImportErrorWithNullError
methods.description: Ensures that persisting I18NImportError without Error throws a NotNullConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NImportErrorWithNullImportedBy
methods.description: Ensures that persisting I18NImportError without imported Employee throws a NotNullConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testGetDecorator
methods.description: Checks that the getDecorator() method returns an instance of I18NImportErrorDecorator.

methods.name: testI18NImportErrorWithDecorator
methods.description: Tests setting related entities via the decorator and verifies their retrieval.
